prompt.project_info: Create a bright vertical vacation-rental doorway portrait of an adult woman with a natural, happy summer mood.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with long straight center-parted hair, warm sun-kissed skin, a slim fit build, and a broad beaming smile. She wears a black triangle bikini with light baby-pink piping and matching side-tie bottoms, a delicate gold butterfly necklace, neon green event wristband, and a small non-graphic forearm tattoo. Preserve natural makeup and visible silver braces if present in the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: She stands in a white sliding-door threshold facing forward, arms extended to hold the doorframe at shoulder height, legs straight with one foot slightly crossed. Behind her is a vacation rental with grey sectional sofa, white coffee table, visible kitchen with white cabinets and dark counters, pendant lights, dining chairs, neutral walls, and a beige woven rug.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight from the front illuminates the subject; the interior background is dimmer with soft artificial light. Happy confident carefree vacation atmosphere, crisp subject and gently softened background.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical portrait, eye-level straight-on camera, sharp subject focus, realistic skin, hair, fabric, rug, and interior texture, natural perspective, social-media-ready detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Vertical 9:16 descriptive portrait of an adult blonde woman with long straight center-parted hair, warm sun-kissed skin, a slim fit build, and a broad beaming happy confident smile. She wears a black triangle bikini top with light baby-pink piping and matching black bottoms with pink piping and side-tie strings, a delicate gold butterfly necklace, neon green event wristband on her left wrist, and a small non-graphic tattoo on her inner right forearm. She stands in a white sliding-door threshold facing forward, arms extended to hold the doorframe at shoulder height, legs straight with the right foot slightly forward and crossed. Show a beige woven rug, grey sectional sofa with pillows, white coffee table with dark top, rear kitchen with white cabinets, dark countertops, pendant lights, dining chairs, neutral walls, and a white door. Natural front daylight on subject, dimmer interior background, eye-level straight-on, sharp subject focus, softly softened background, carefree vacation mood.
